description: Translate short texts accurately, keeping numbers and meaning.

tests.prompt: Translate into Spanish: 'The meeting has been moved to Thursday at 3 pm; please bring your laptop.'
tests.rubric: Correct, natural Spanish that keeps all facts (meeting moved, Thursday, 3 pm, bring laptop). Minor stylistic variation is fine. Penalize extra commentary only mildly.
tests.reference: La reunión se ha cambiado al jueves a las 3 pm; por favor, traiga su portátil.

tests.prompt: Translate into English: 'Je voudrais réserver une table pour quatre personnes ce soir à vingt heures.'
tests.rubric: Accurate English that keeps: reserve a table, four people, tonight, at 8 o'clock (8 pm / 20:00).
tests.reference: I would like to book a table for four people tonight at eight o'clock.
